name: Shell Session
summary: A dark terminal by default, a light page when the system asks. Real output in terminal blocks, and a mark on every command for what it can do to your files. For pages that teach or explain something people will run.

for: tutorials and references for commands, code or tools
tools that judge risk before something is run

pairs.role: text the can-delete mark on a card

type.display: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
type.text: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
type.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

shape.note: terminal blocks stay dark in both modes and wrap instead of scrolling the page; controls use a border at 3:1 or better

signature.name: the measured pipeline
signature.rule: One continuous pipe in a terminal window, one segment per command of a real pipeline. Thickness is the number of lines flowing at an exact scale (no minimum size), and each segment runs from the lines that came in to the lines it let out, so it narrows where lines are thrown away. The measured count is above each segment, the command below it, the real final output beneath, and a one-line key says what thickness means. The poster is dark in both colour schemes and the header joins it.
signature.carries: how much data each stage of a real pipeline lets through, measured, at an honest scale
signature.derived_from: scripts/run_examples.py running each prefix of data/pipeline.json | wc -l

motifs.rule: Show the command, then exactly what it printed, produced by a real run in a sandbox at build time. A build that has an example without a recorded output refuses to run, and a --check re-runs everything and compares.

A rule style plus a word for what it can do in ordinary use: solid Only reads, dashed Changes things, double warm Can delete data. A flag riskier than its command carries its own mark. Never colour alone.

A fourth verdict, dotted and worded Can't tell, for anything the tool could not analyse. A tool that judges risk never reports an unanalysed part as safe; it lists the specific reasons under the verdict.
Previous and Next links at the end of every lesson so a learner is never left at a footer.
Saturated colour is spent only on the data (the pipe) and the primary action; the headline, counts and kicker stay neutral, so the colour ranks what matters.

allowed: blinking cursor in the brand mark

never: an output that was typed by hand
reporting an unanalysed part as safe
a danger mark defined more narrowly than the things it is applied to
advice to quote "$dir/*" (the wildcard must stay outside the quotes: "$dir"/*)
a control border under 3:1 or placeholder text under 4.5:1
a minimum size on a data mark that distorts its proportion (3 of 40 drawn as 0.117 instead of 0.075)
a hero graphic that is only explained by a caption below the fold: put a one-line key beside it
a nowrap headline (it clips at large text sizes)
a hero that is unreadable in print
